g.aria-label: Input-Dependent Affine Recurrence: Parallel Projection + Scan
Selective Clock Gating via Input-Driven Survival Factor a_t ∈ (0, 1)^d
• Informative token x_t → a_{t,i} ≈ 0: flushes stale coordinate i and writes fresh candidate b_{t,i}
• Uninformative filler x_t → a_{t,i} ≈ 1: freezes coordinate i (h_{t,i} ≈ h_{t-1,i}) with zero decay
